findings.observation: Reads current pointer into1024-byte slot, invokes parser, acknowledges present before propagating parser result
findings.implication: Bad packet consumes slot; caller must not parse again or acknowledge twice

findings.observation: Clears present then error with explicit assumption CPU outruns two arrivals
findings.implication: Not an atomic full-ring drain or epoch freshness proof

findings.observation: Locks AUX mutex, sends, waits one reply; assumes no async setup packets, no explicit pre-send queue drain
findings.implication: Exclusive CPU ownership prevents concurrent software transactions but does not correlate stale/duplicate ACK

findings.observation: One recv_aux_timeout per live link under mutex
findings.implication: Not a bounded drain-until-empty guarantee for multi-slot backlog

findings.observation: Unbounded busy-wait until TX clears in upstream source
findings.implication: Do not reuse directly for bounded A53 callback contract

findings.observation: Requires length8; laboratory/upstream receive provides fixed1024-byte slot
findings.implication: Transport adapter must identify fixed ACK envelope prefix and pass exactly8 bytes; slot tail is not extra frame bytes

candidate_contract.ownership: Single exclusive link owner; no unsolicited setup traffic; no concurrent consumer
candidate_contract.preflight: Bounded check of RX error, present and ownership before TX; queued packet causes fail-closed refusal, never silently discard to claim freshness
candidate_contract.receive: Snapshot stable slot/pointer under mapped producer/consumer contract, decode fixed8byte ACK prefix, acknowledge exactly once even on decode rejection
candidate_contract.bounds: Bound send busy/bridge and receive polling; surface ambiguous TX commit and require explicit recovery rather than retry
candidate_contract.epoch: External peer-reset/drain/quiescence qualification required. Empty queue snapshot alone cannot rule out delayed old ACK
candidate_contract.unsupported: No proof against physical delayed duplicate ACK after preflight; protocol wire has no ID

limits: Read-only local source audit, not compiled transport/MMIO or physical ring proof
No timing/quiet interval inferred; no reset/drain/HW action performed
next_safe_offline: Implement isolated fixed-slot RoutingAck adapter with exactly-once slot release and malformed-prefix tests using host mock ownership callbacks; no MMIO/epoch claims
